modern: It is your duty to order your life well in every single act; and if every act does its duty as far as possible, be content; and no one is able to stop you so that each act does not do its duty.—But something external will stand in the way. Nothing will stand in the way of your acting justly and soberly and thoughtfully.—But perhaps some other active power will be hindered. Well, by accepting the hindrance and by being content to transfer your efforts to what is allowed, another opportunity for action is immediately put before you in place of the one that was hindered, and one which will fit in with this ordering we are speaking of.
original: It is thy duty to order thy life well in every single act; and if every act does its duty as far as is possible, be content; and no one is able to hinder thee so that each act shall not do its duty.—But something external will stand in the way. Nothing will stand in the way of thy acting justly and soberly and considerately.—But perhaps some other active power will be hindered. Well, but by acquiescing in the hindrance and by being content to transfer thy efforts to that which is allowed, another opportunity of action is immediately put before thee in place of that which was hindered, and one which will adapt itself to this ordering of which we are speaking.

notification_original: It is thy duty to order thy life well in every single act; and if every act does its duty as far as is possible, be content…

explained.summary:
Your job is to make each action as good as it can be, and if you manage that, be content. No one can stop you doing that. Something outside may block a particular plan, but nothing can stop you acting fairly, sensibly and thoughtfully.

If a plan is blocked, accept it calmly and turn your effort to what is still possible. A new opportunity for acting well appears at once in place of the old one.
explained.today: The flight is cancelled, the funding falls through, the job goes to someone else. The original plan is gone, but the chance to handle it well, and to put the energy into the next possible thing, is still entirely yours.
